emergency.condition_text: turn six or later, fewer than three creatures on the battlefield, and the cheap spells in hand have nothing to copy through.
indications: Fewer than three creatures on the battlefield after turn five.
Crimson Wisps, Expedite, Accelerate or Renegade Tactics in hand with one creature to copy to.
Zada or Storm-Kiln Artist on the battlefield under an otherwise empty board.
Dragon Fodder, Krenko's Command, Goblin Instigator, Mogg War Marshal and Searslicer Goblin all still unseen.
Land drops landing on time and the hand the same size it was three turns ago.
immediate: Cast the cheapest body in hand before any cantrip: Dragon Fodder, Krenko's Command, Goblin Instigator or Mogg War Marshal.
Cast Goblin Matron and fetch Mogg War Marshal or Goblin Instigator.
Cast Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for the Goblin Shaman; at chapter II, discard Battle Hymn and Brightstone Ritual, keeping every creature.
Hold Crimson Wisps, Expedite, Accelerate and Renegade Tactics until three creatures are on the battlefield.
Attack with one creature so Searslicer Goblin makes a Goblin at your end step.
subsequent: Rebuild to three bodies before you spend a cantrip on Zada.
Channel Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance at an opponent's end step for two Spirits; it costs {1} less for each legendary creature you control.
Activate Kher Keep for {1}{R} at every opponent's end step you leave mana open.
Cast Empty the Warrens off Brightstone Ritual or Battle Hymn and skip the Zada turn: stack 002 is checker-passed and names no commander.
Recast Zada once, at {5}{R}. After that, spend the mana on bodies.
emergency.notes: Heat Shimmer and Molten Duplication copy one creature each when cast at Zada with nothing beside her: the copy is a second Zada, and the legend rule takes it (stack 017). On a stalled board cast them at Mogg War Marshal or Goblin Instigator instead, so the enters trigger makes a Goblin that stays.

emergency.condition_text: an opponent kills the table before you have a board, and you cannot answer it on board.
indications: An opponent with a token maker and a damage payoff both on the battlefield by turn three.
Two or more mono-red decks at the table.
Your life below 30 before your fourth land drop.
Every creature in your hand costing four or more.
An opponent's Krenko, Mob Boss or another creature tapping for value every turn.
immediate: Cast Harsh Mentor before the racer's next turn; each non-mana activation of their artifacts, creatures and lands deals 2 damage to them.
Cast Abrade for 3 damage at the racer's engine creature, not their largest body.
Cast every creature you can afford each turn and keep them home as blockers.
Cast Blasphemous Act once six or more creatures are on the battlefield; it costs {1} less for each of them.
Cast Empty the Warrens at whatever storm count you have — two tokens per copy is blockers.
subsequent: Attack the racer and only the racer until they are dead.
Spend Grapeshot, Goblin Bombardment and Siege-Gang Commander's activation on their creatures rather than on their life total.
Cast Untimely Malfunction on their artifact, or choose two of their creatures that can't block on the turn you swing back.
Cast Past in Flames once the graveyard holds Dragon Fodder or Krenko's Command, a ritual and Grapeshot.
emergency.notes: Blasphemous Act deals 13 to each creature and kills your board with theirs. With Pashalik Mons on the battlefield first, every one of your own Goblin deaths is a point aimed at any target, and the card stops being a reset. Pashalik Mons dies to it too, and still triggers for each Goblin that dies at the same time.

emergency.condition_text: a sweeper is coming and the board is the whole plan.
indications: An opponent in white or black holding four or more mana open through your turn.
A seat that has cast nothing for two turns with cards in hand.
Your board at six or more creatures with Pashalik Mons not on the battlefield.
Blasphemous Act in your own hand costing four or less — the board that cheapens it for you cheapens theirs.
immediate: With the sweeper on the stack, cast Battle Hymn or Brightstone Ritual; both are instants and both read the board that is about to die.
Spend that mana on Crimson Wisps, Expedite, Accelerate or Fists of Flame targeting only Zada — every copy draws a card before the sweeper resolves.
Sacrifice the remaining creatures to Goblin Bombardment, one damage each at the opponent closest to dead.
Return Zada to the command zone rather than the graveyard.
At the end of that opponent's turn, channel Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance for {3}{R}: two Spirits that can attack on your turn.
subsequent: Rebuild to three bodies, not eight. A second sweeper answers eight as easily as three.
Play Pashalik Mons before the next token maker, so the following sweeper pays you a point per Goblin.
Cast Past in Flames and flash back Dragon Fodder, Krenko's Command and the rituals the sweeper turn put in the graveyard.
If an opponent's board survived the sweeper and yours did not, cast Blasphemous Act on it; at seven creatures it costs {1}{R}.
Cast Empty the Warrens off Brightstone Ritual and Battle Hymn instead of recasting Zada at {5}{R}.
emergency.notes: Plaza of Heroes saves Zada from a destroy or damage sweeper — {3}, tap, exile: hexproof and indestructible. It does not save her from exile, a sacrifice effect or -X/-X. Skullclamp equips only as a sorcery: attach it in your main phase on a turn you expect the sweeper.

emergency.condition_text: Zada, or the one permanent this turn is built on, is targeted.
indications: An opponent with two mana open in a colour that answers a creature, during your turn.
Zada on the battlefield with three or more other creatures and a cantrip, Heat Shimmer or Molten Duplication in your hand.
Storm-Kiln Artist or Krenko, Mob Boss on the battlefield and untapped.
Swiftfoot Boots on the battlefield attached to nothing.
immediate: If you control Zada and hold Deflecting Swat, cast it for free and move the removal to a creature the caster controls.
If not, cast Untimely Malfunction for {1}{R}, change-the-target mode, at the same spell.
If neither is in hand and Plaza of Heroes is untapped with {3} beside it, activate it on Zada: hexproof and indestructible, and the removal has no legal target.
With mana left, cast Crimson Wisps, Expedite, Accelerate or Fists of Flame targeting only Zada before the removal resolves; every copy draws.
If nothing answered it, return Zada to the command zone rather than the graveyard.
subsequent: Cast Hexing Squelcher before you recast Zada; every other creature you control has ward—pay 2 life.
Equip Swiftfoot Boots to Zada in your main phase, before the first cantrip rather than after it.
Recast Zada at {5}{R} only with three or more creatures already on the battlefield.
Run the storm half without her: Battle Hymn and Brightstone Ritual into Empty the Warrens with Impact Tremors on the battlefield is checker-passed and names no commander (stack 002).
emergency.notes: Deflecting Swat is free only while you control a commander; with Zada in the command zone it costs {2}{R}. Deflecting Swat, Plaza of Heroes and Untimely Malfunction answer a spell that targets; Untimely Malfunction only one with a single target. None of them answers a sacrifice effect or a sweeper. Heat Shimmer, Molten Duplication, Renegade Tactics, Ancestral Anger and Wild Ride are sorceries and cannot be cast with removal on the stack.

emergency.condition_text: an opponent is assembling a loop, and the piece is an artifact or a creature you can reach at instant speed.
indications: An opponent searching their library twice in one turn.
An opponent untapping with six or more mana and cards in hand.
A permanent entering that has ended a game at this table before.
A loop that repeats an activated ability of an artifact, creature or land.
immediate: Cast Abrade on the piece already on the battlefield: destroy an artifact, or 3 damage to a creature.
Cast Untimely Malfunction on a second artifact piece, or change the target of the spell or ability that assembles the loop.
Cast Deflecting Swat on a spell or ability of theirs that targets, free while Zada is on the battlefield, and choose a new target for it.
Cast Harsh Mentor if the loop activates an artifact, creature or land: each activation deals 2 damage to its controller.
Attack the combo seat with the whole board and keep nothing back for a second turn.
subsequent: Point Goblin Bombardment, Pashalik Mons, Grapeshot and Siege-Gang Commander at the combo seat until it is dead.
Cast Empty the Warrens and Grapeshot on the turn you hold them rather than waiting for a larger storm count.
Cast Hexing Squelcher before the storm turn so a counterspell cannot stop the kill.
Tell the seat holding counterspells which permanent you cannot answer, and ask them to hold up mana for it.
emergency.notes: An enchantment, a land or a graveyard loop is answered by killing the player, and the clock for that is the board you already have. Harsh Mentor does not trigger on a mana ability, so a loop that only taps for mana passes it.

emergency.condition_text: the land drops have stopped, or the lands in play make no red.
indications: Three lands on turn five.
Spinerock Knoll in hand, or Arena of Glory and Castle Embereth with no Mountain on the battlefield; each enters tapped.
Fountainport, Goblin Burrows, Kher Keep, Reliquary Tower, Three Tree City or War Room as your only untapped land.
A hand of four- and five-drops with Sol Ring undrawn.
immediate: Cast Sol Ring ahead of any body.
Cast Skirk Prospector and Impulsive Pilferer: one turns a Goblin into {R}, the other becomes a Treasure when it dies.
Cast Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and attack with the Shaman for a Treasure; at chapter II, discard the five-drops.
Cast Ancestors' Aid, Sudden Breakthrough or Reckless Ransacking on a creature for the Treasure.
Activate War Room for {3}, a tap and one life at the end of a turn you cast nothing.
subsequent: Play Den of the Bugbear as your first or second land; with two or more other lands it enters tapped.
Name Goblin for Three Tree City. Activate it for {2} with three or more Goblins on the battlefield: three nets one red, each Goblin beyond that one more.
Cast Brightstone Ritual with two or more Goblins on the battlefield and Battle Hymn with three or more creatures; below that they cost more than they add.
Activate Fountainport for {2} and a spare token to draw a card once the board is wide enough to lose one.
emergency.notes: Six of the fifteen land entries — Fountainport, Goblin Burrows, Kher Keep, Reliquary Tower, Three Tree City and War Room — tap for {C} and no red. Plaza of Heroes makes red for a legendary spell, or once you control a red legendary permanent; on turn two with no legend out it makes {C}. Count red sources rather than lands when you decide whether a hand casts {R}{R} on turn two.

emergency.condition_text: the table has decided you are the deck to kill, and the board is 1/1s.
indications: Two seats attacking you while a third builds.
An opponent naming Zada before you have cast her.
Removal aimed at Impact Tremors or Goblin Bombardment rather than at a creature.
The table stops trading with each other the turn after you cast Empty the Warrens.
immediate: Cast the payoff this turn rather than the turn after: Empty the Warrens, Grapeshot or Fists of Flame, at whatever count you have.
Sacrifice Goblins to Goblin Bombardment and Siege-Gang Commander at the seat with the lowest life, before the board is answered.
Leave Zada in the command zone and run the line that names no commander (stack 002).
Block with the 1/1s. A body absorbing an attack is worth more than a copy count you never spend.
subsequent: Attack the seat that attacked you, not the seat that is winning, until they stop.
Rebuild only to the number of bodies you will spend next turn.
Cast Hexing Squelcher: every creature you control, Squelcher included, has ward—pay 2 life, so a spell aimed at one of them is countered unless its caster pays 2 life.
Cast Deflecting Swat or Untimely Malfunction on a removal spell aimed at another seat once, out loud.
emergency.notes: In the 2026-09-02 Forge run, on the v1.0.0 list, against giada-angels, baylen-tokens and abaddon, the pod aimed a mean 0.31 interaction spells per game at this seat, against 1.21 received by giada-angels, and this seat was still eliminated in 90 of 100 games. Forge's AI does not read a Goblin board; a table does.

keep: Two to five lands, at least two of them adding red.

A creature costing two or less, or a token maker: Skirk Prospector, Goblin Lackey, Goblin Bushwhacker, Impulsive Pilferer, Goblin Instigator, Hexing Squelcher, Mogg War Marshal, Searslicer Goblin, Rundvelt Hordemaster, Grenzo, Havoc Raiser, Conspicuous Snoop, Dragon Fodder, Krenko's Command.
A second body reachable by turn three from the cards in hand.
A red source you can tap on turn one.
Kher Keep counts as a body source: {1}{R} and a tap makes a 0/1 Kobold, every turn.
ship: Cantrips and a copy engine with no creature under three mana. That is the hand that lost game 001: clean lands, one-mana instants and sorceries, Storm-Kiln Artist, zero Goblins.
A hand whose cheapest creature costs four or more. Three basics, Dwarven Mine and Krenko, Mob Boss is the hand that lost game 002.

Rituals or copy spells with no board: Battle Hymn adds {R} for each creature you control, Brightstone Ritual for each Goblin on the battlefield, Heat Shimmer and Molten Duplication copy what is already there.
One land with no Sol Ring.
preflight.note: Dwarven Mine is a body as well as a land, and it arrives late: it enters tapped unless you already control three other Mountains, and only an untapped Dwarven Mine makes the 1/1 Dwarf. That Dwarf counts for Zada's copy count and for Battle Hymn, and it is not a Goblin, so Brightstone Ritual does not count it. Game 002's opener was three basics, Dwarven Mine and Krenko, Mob Boss — the Dwarf was a turn-four body at the earliest, and the hand was shipped too late.

steps: Play an untapped red source on turn one. Play Den of the Bugbear by turn two; hold Spinerock Knoll for a turn you cast nothing.
Cast a one-mana Goblin on turn one: Skirk Prospector, Goblin Lackey, Impulsive Pilferer, or Goblin Bushwhacker unkicked.
Cast Dragon Fodder, Krenko's Command or Goblin Instigator on turn two, ahead of Sol Ring and ahead of any cantrip.
Cast a third body on turn three: Mogg War Marshal, Searslicer Goblin, Hexing Squelcher, Legion Warboss, or Goblin Matron fetching one of them.
Count the creatures at the end of turn three. Cast Zada on turn four only if that count is three or more.
startup.note: Mogg War Marshal's echo is {1}{R} at your next upkeep. Declining it sacrifices the Marshal and makes another Goblin, so the body count is two either way — pay the echo only on a turn a third body changes a copy count.

steps: Play Impact Tremors or General Kreat, the Boltbringer before the next token maker resolves; each creature entering afterwards is a damage trigger at every opponent.
Play Goblin Warchief or Goblin Chieftain before Krenko, Mob Boss. The Warchief locks Krenko at {1}{R}{R} and the haste is what lets him tap the turn he lands (stack 004).
Cast Hexing Squelcher, then Zada, with three or more other creatures already on the battlefield.
Equip Swiftfoot Boots to Zada in your main phase, before the first cantrip.
Cast Crimson Wisps, Expedite or Accelerate targeting only Zada. Four other creatures is four copies plus the original: five cards and a hasty team (stack 001).
assembly.note: Heat Shimmer or Molten Duplication cast at Zada alone copies every other creature with haste. Four creatures with Mogg War Marshal among them become eight, three of them hasty, for {2}{R} (stack 017). The original copies Zada last and the legend rule makes you choose: keep the original, which is your commander. Heat Shimmer's tokens are exiled at the end step and do not die; Molten Duplication's are sacrificed and do.

steps: Play the land. Play the untapped one, play Spinerock Knoll on a turn you cast nothing, and keep Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance in hand for its channel while other land drops remain.
Cast a body before you cast a spell.
Count the creatures on the battlefield. That number is Zada's copy count, Battle Hymn's mana and Impact Tremors' damage per creature entering.
Attack with at least one creature so Searslicer Goblin makes a Goblin at your end step, and so Grenzo, Havoc Raiser turns combat damage into a card off that player's library.
Activate Idol of Oblivion at your end step on any turn a token entered.
Hold Abrade, Untimely Malfunction and Deflecting Swat with their mana open through the other seats' turns.
cruise.note: Storm counts spells CAST. Copies are put on the stack without being cast, so Empty the Warrens at storm count 3 makes eight tokens and a Grapeshot after it still sees a count of 4 (stack 002).

steps: Count the creatures on the battlefield and add Zada. That number is the copy count.

Total the damage before you cast anything: Impact Tremors and General Kreat pay one per creature entering, Purphoros two once it is on the battlefield, Goblin Bombardment one per body, Pashalik Mons one per Goblin death, Siege-Gang Commander two per Goblin eaten.
If the total is short of a seat's life, pass the turn with the payoff in hand and add a body.
If it is lethal, cast Hexing Squelcher first, then Heat Shimmer or Molten Duplication targeting only Zada for hasty copies, then Accelerate targeting only Zada for team haste and a card per creature.
After blockers are declared, cast Fists of Flame targeting only Zada, then sacrifice the blocked Goblins to Goblin Bombardment at the player you are killing.
closing.note: Fists of Flame's copies do not grow retroactively. Each copy draws before it pumps, so the order they resolve in sets the size: stack 003 locks the tokens at +3/+0, +4/+0, +5/+0, +6/+0 and Zada at +7/+0 with trample, 32 power in total. The token copies from Heat Shimmer and Molten Duplication enter after the count is taken; cast the copy spell first and the cantrip second, so the cantrip copies to them too.

optics: Deploy bodies first and the damage payoff last. Four 1/1s draw no removal; four 1/1s beside Impact Tremors draw all of it.
Keep Krenko, Mob Boss in hand until the turn you can tap him — a Krenko that survives to untap is the table's first target.
Say what the board does when asked. A count of 1/1s is public information and the number the table is bad at is the copy count, not the board.
Cast the rituals in the same turn as the payoff. A Battle Hymn on an empty turn tells the table there is a storm turn coming.
reveal: Hold Empty the Warrens, Heat Shimmer, Molten Duplication and Fists of Flame until the turn they kill a seat.
Hold Deflecting Swat until a removal spell targets Zada; it is free only while she is on the battlefield.
Cast Grapeshot early only to kill a creature that is racing you; otherwise it is the last five points.
Play Impact Tremors on the turn the token maker follows it, not two turns before.
Cast Zada on a board of three or more. She reads as a 3/3 to a table that has not seen the cantrips.
alliances: Offer Goblin Bombardment, Abrade and Untimely Malfunction as the table's removal and spend them on the seat that is winning.
Say plainly that nothing in the deck touches an enchantment, a land or a graveyard, and ask the seat that carries those answers to spend theirs.
Trade a turn of not attacking a seat for a turn of them not attacking you, and take the deal that buys two turns rather than one.
Break the deal on the turn the board is lethal, and say so before you declare attackers.
targets: Point every optional damage — Goblin Bombardment, Pashalik Mons, Siege-Gang Commander, Broadside Bombardiers, Grapeshot — at one seat until it is dead. Spread across three seats it kills nobody.
Attack the seat with the fewest untapped blockers; 1/1s connect where nothing blocks and nowhere else.
Cast Abrade on the permanent that beats you, not the permanent that is biggest.
Redirect a removal spell with Deflecting Swat or Untimely Malfunction onto the creature of the seat that cast it.
Kill the seat holding a sweeper before the seat holding a bigger board.
